title: Postmortem & Customer Comms for Regional Capacity Degradation (2026-02-23)
text:
Postmortem & Customer Comms for Regional Capacity Degradation (2026-02-23)

description:
Summary: On 2026-02-23 between 17:02 and 17:47 UTC Redwood experienced a regional capacity degradation affecting hosted inference endpoints in us-west-2. Symptom: elevated 503/timeout errors and increased tail latency for short-lived chat requests. Immediate mitigation: traffic reroute to us-east-1 and enabling reduced batching mode for affected nodes. This ticket tracks the postmortem, customer-facing status page copy, and actionable RCA items for preventing recurrence.

incident_summary:
2026-02-23 17:02 UTC: first elevated errors detected by SLO alerting. 17:10 UTC: automated scaling failed due to allocator regression; 17:20 UTC: ops initiated cross-region failover; 17:47 UTC: error rates returned to baseline after throttling and draining affected pools. Root cause identified as allocator change in runtime-1.22 that regressed capacity accounting under high-concurrency prefix-cached workloads.

root_cause:
A change in the allocation algorithm (commit abc123 in runtime-1.22) introduced a race between kernel selection and shard accounting which under high concurrent KV cache hits caused double-counting of available slots, leading to oversubscription and request queue saturation.

action_items:
ENG-4722: Revert allocator change in runtime-1.22 and ship hotfix (owner: Liam Chen, estimate: 3)
ENG-4723: Add unit and stress tests for allocator race conditions (owner: Priya Kapoor, estimate: 5)
ENG-4724: Improve SLO alerting to separate allocator-oversubscription signals from pure infra failures (owner: Aaron Moore, estimate: 3)
ENG-4725: Run cross-region failover drill and update runbook (owner: On-call Squad, estimate: 2)
ENG-4726: Customer comms template and post-incident status page update (owner: Sofia Alvarez, estimate: 1)

timeline:
2026-02-23 17:02 UTC - SLO alert: increased 5xx rate for us-west-2
2026-02-23 17:10 UTC - Ops observed allocator errors in node logs; retries increased
2026-02-23 17:18 UTC - Decision to reroute 40% traffic to us-east-1 as partial mitigation
2026-02-23 17:22 UTC - Reduced batching and disabled prefetching on affected service
2026-02-23 17:47 UTC - Error rates returned to baseline after draining and hotfix revert
2026-02-24 09:00 UTC - Initial RCA draft posted to Confluence
2026-02-25 14:15 UTC - Customer-facing incident summary posted to status.redwood.com
2026-03-02 11:30 UTC - Engineering review of proposed fixes; owner assignments made

comments:
2026-02-25 Sofia Alvarez: Initial ticket created and customer comms draft attached to Confluence. Notified PM and Support to prepare outbound emails.
2026-03-01 Liam Chen: Hotfix PR #1829 opened; CI stress tests still unstable on some kernels. Need prioritization.
2026-03-03 Priya Kapoor: Added allocator race unit tests and reproduced failure in load harness; tests added to flaky-suite for now.
2026-03-05 Aaron Moore: Proposed update to SLO alerting rules to add allocator-oversubscription flag - awaiting security review for metric exposure.
2026-03-09 Sofia Alvarez: Customer-facing timeline refined; legal reviewed copy for enterprise customers.
2026-03-10 Liam Chen: Marked In Review; waiting on PM sign-off for rollout plan and scheduled canary for 2026-03-16.
